audit.why: Favourable poke lane, difficulty 7/10, chart Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Galio, Ziggs, Ziggs — full and content layers already agree row for row, and the mirror (galio__ziggs) states the same rows.
audit.corrected: No chart change. win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side match each other and the mirror; only the why-text needed to stop contradicting the sides it sits on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 text on both layers claimed Ziggs flips the 1v1, while the chart row for Level 6 says Galio.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s at 4000/4750/5500 range and lands his jungler on you; that is the reason the row is Galio. Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s at 650; Shield of Durand 18s. Your own timers: Satchel Charge 20s at rank 1 (1000 range), Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s (900), Bouncing Bomb 6s to 4s (850), Mega Inferno Bomb 120s (5000).
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Galio because of Hero's Entrance, not because his duel improves.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly said Winds of War out-ranges you and heals him, and called his passive a magic shield.
audit.why: Winds of War is 825 range against Bouncing Bomb's 850 — you out-range it by twenty-five units — and Riot's description has no healing on it at all. The passive is Colossal Smash, an auto-attack reset dealing bonus magic damage in an area. The shielding and magic damage reduction are Shield of Durand (W), the passive shield being 7.5% max health and blocked from recharging by continuous chip.
audit.corrected: Out-range him by a hair, chip constantly to keep the Shield of Durand shield from recharging, and read the Colossal Smash wind-up as the all-in tell rather than the Justice Punch cast.

audit.why: Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset — his combo opens with the wind-up, which precedes Justice Punch.

edits.before: Level 1 Ziggs pokes before Galio's Q sustain and shield come online.
edits.after: Level 1 Bouncing Bomb's 850 out-ranges Winds of War by twenty-five units.

edits.before: At level 2 Galio's Winds of War healing and magic shield win the poke war.
edits.after: Level 2 gives you Satchel Charge (W) — greedy trades, then blast yourself out.

edits.before: By level 3 Galio still out-sustains and out-ranges Ziggs' early poke.
edits.after: Level 3 is even: his 825 Q trades with your 850 Q, mines cover your retreat.

edits.before: At 6 Ziggs' Mega Inferno Bomb and mines flip the 1v1 in his favour.
edits.after: At 6 Hero's Entrance drops his jungler on you from 4000 range.

edits.before: On first item Galio's Q-slow E-taunt all-in is his strongest burst window.
edits.after: First item: Blackfire Torch chip beats a shield he can never recharge.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Galio on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb's 850 beats Winds of War's 825 by a hair — chunk him on every last-hit, but respect minion aggro.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is up: 180s at rank 1, 4000 range, and it lands his jungler on you. Ward, and never sit low while it is off cooldown.

edits.before: Early, Galio's Winds of War (Q) out-ranges and out-sustains your poke — its two tornadoes heal him and out-trade your Bouncing Bomb (Q) if you stand still. His magic-shield passive also eats your AP burst, so at 2-3 he wins the poke war; play the wave, dodge his Q, and don't extend into his Justice Punch (E) flash range.
edits.after: Early, Winds of War (Q) reaches 825 to your Bouncing Bomb's 850 — you win that trade by twenty-five units, so keep walking back as you cast. What eats your poke is Shield of Durand: the passive shield is 7.5% max health and only constant chip keeps it from recharging. Stay outside Justice Punch (E), 650 range and down 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: His level-6 taunt-engage window (Q slow into E-taunt all-in) is Galio's peak — with a completed item his combo can burst you if he lands the E. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) behind you and hold Satchel Charge (W) to knock yourself out of his E flash range.
edits.after: His all-in is Justice Punch (E) into Shield of Durand (W) taunt, and it opens with a Colossal Smash (P) auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to leave, not the cast. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) behind you and hold Satchel Charge (W) to blast out of the taunt.

edits.before: Galio's Winds of War (Q) out-ranges and heals through your poke early, and his magic-shield passive soaks your AP burst — at 2-3 he wins the poke war outright. Don't stand in his tornadoes, farm safely, and stay out of Justice Punch (E) flash range.
edits.after: Winds of War (Q) is 825 to your 850 — you out-range it by twenty-five units, not by a screen. Shield of Durand's passive shield is 7.5% max health, so constant bomb chip stops it recharging. Farm from max range and stay outside his 650 Justice Punch (E).

edits.before: Winning the early poke war with Q healing + magic-shield passive
edits.after: Chipping you down behind a recharging Shield of Durand shield
